description: This file defines functions for adding TensorFlow operations, specifically focusing on creating constant tensor operations within a computational graph. It includes licensing information, package declaration, imports, and the implementation of the Const function which adds a 'Const' operation to the graph.

methods.name: Const
methods.description: Adds a 'Const' operation to the TensorFlow graph within the provided scope, producing a constant tensor output based on the given value.
